## Description
Provide a concise explanation of the changes introduced in this PR and why they are necessary.

## Related Issues
Closes #(issue number)

## Type of Change
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] Chore / Refactoring

## Quality & Hygiene Checklist
- [ ] All unit tests pass (`cd server && npm test`)
- [ ] Client builds successfully without errors (`cd client && npm run build`)
- [ ] Client code adheres to style guidelines and passes linting (`cd client && npm run lint`)
- [ ] No secrets, private API keys, or `.env` files are staged or committed
- [ ] Documentation has been added or updated (`README.md`, `docs/`, etc.)
- [ ] Commit messages follow the conventional commits specification
